en: Beep beep! The little green bus starts its trip. The driver waves. Nobody is on board yet.
Stop one! Grandma climbs on with a basket of bananas. One friend on the bus.
Stop two! A boy with a blue kite climbs on. Two friends on the bus.
Stop three! A girl with a yellow umbrella climbs on. Three friends on the bus.
The bus stops at the park. Everyone climbs off and says, 'Thank you, driver!'
id: Tin tin! Angkot hijau kecil mulai berjalan. Pak sopir melambai. Belum ada penumpang.
Pemberhentian satu! Nenek naik membawa keranjang pisang. Satu teman di angkot.
Pemberhentian dua! Anak laki-laki membawa layang-layang biru naik. Dua teman di angkot.
Pemberhentian tiga! Anak perempuan membawa payung kuning naik. Tiga teman di angkot.
Angkot berhenti di taman. Semua turun dan berkata, 'Terima kasih, Pak Sopir!'

readAloudNotes.en: Hold a pretend steering wheel and say 'Beep beep!' together.
readAloudNotes.id: Pegang setir pura-pura dan ucapkan 'Tin tin!' bersama.

readAloudNotes.en: Hold up one finger and pretend to carry a heavy basket.
readAloudNotes.id: Angkat satu jari dan pura-pura membawa keranjang yang berat.

readAloudNotes.en: Hold up two fingers and fly a pretend kite.
readAloudNotes.id: Angkat dua jari dan terbangkan layang-layang pura-pura.

readAloudNotes.en: Hold up three fingers and open a pretend umbrella. Count all three again.
readAloudNotes.id: Angkat tiga jari dan buka payung pura-pura. Hitung ketiganya lagi.

readAloudNotes.en: Wave goodbye and say thank you in a cheerful voice.
readAloudNotes.id: Lambaikan tangan dan ucapkan terima kasih dengan riang.

objectives.en: Counts on by one as each passenger joins: one, two, three.
objectives.id: Menghitung maju satu per satu saat setiap penumpang naik: satu, dua, tiga.

objectives.en: Remembers to say thank you to people who help us.
objectives.id: Ingat mengucapkan terima kasih kepada orang yang membantu kita.

meaning.en: a person riding in a bus or car
meaning.id: orang yang naik bus atau mobil

meaning.en: a place where a bus waits for people

prompt.en: How many passengers were on the bus when it reached the park?
prompt.id: Ada berapa penumpang di angkot saat sampai di taman?

prompt.en: Who got on the bus first?
prompt.id: Siapa yang naik angkot pertama kali?

en: a person riding on the bus

prompt.en: Why did everyone thank the driver?
prompt.id: Mengapa semua berterima kasih kepada sopir?

en: he took them where they wanted to go
id: dia mengantar mereka ke tempat tujuan

connection.en: Each stop adds one more passenger, so we count on: one, two, three.
connection.id: Setiap pemberhentian menambah satu penumpang, jadi kita menghitung maju: satu, dua, tiga.

connection.en: Many towns in Indonesia have small minibuses called angkot.
connection.id: Banyak kota di Indonesia punya angkot.

discussionPrompts.en: Who do you say thank you to every day?
discussionPrompts.id: Kepada siapa kamu berterima kasih setiap hari?

discussionPrompts.en: Where would you like the little bus to take you?
discussionPrompts.id: Ke mana kamu ingin angkot kecil mengantarmu?

offlineActivity.en: Line up three chairs as a bus. Your child is the driver and drives soft toys to the 'park', counting one more at every stop.
offlineActivity.id: Susun tiga kursi menjadi angkot. Anak menjadi sopir dan mengantar boneka ke 'taman', menghitung tambah satu di setiap pemberhentian.
